page_title: INT 1-0 VER | Inter v Verona 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Gianluca Manganiello has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) is replacing Domagoj Bradaric.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Matteo Darmian (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
85' The foul by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Gianluca Manganiello.
84' Here's the change. Nicola Zalewski leaves the pitch and Francesco Acerbi (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
83' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Casper Tengstedt (Verona) will replace Ondrej Duda.
80' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Cheikh Niasse and he is replaced by Grigoris Kastanos (Verona).
79' The possession of the ball – 72:28.
77' That will be all from Marko Arnautovic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
76' Joaquin Correa (Inter) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
75' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
71' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Ondrej Duda (Verona), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
69' Here comes a substitution. Antoine Bernede (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Tomas Suslov.
69' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) replaces Amin Sarr.
69' Substitution. Yann Bisseck is replaced by Federico Dimarco (Inter).
68' Masssimiliano Farris prepares a substitution. Piotr Zielinski is replaced by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
68' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.

67' Tomas Suslov (Verona) produces a stunning solo run from the middle of the pitch, all the way to the penalty area. He unleashes a decent strike which goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

66' What a chance that is! Tomas Suslov (Verona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
63' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
62' Stefan de Vrij (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Gianluca Manganiello no option but to blow his whistle.
57' Joaquin Correa (Inter) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
55' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
53' Yann Bisseck (Inter) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

52' Tomas Suslov (Verona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
51' Half-chance! Nicola Zalewski (Inter) plays a pass into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
50' The corner from Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is hurriedly cleared.
49' The corner from Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is intercepted by Lorenzo Montipo.
49' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' A yellow card for a tackle by Nicolas Valentini (Verona). Gianluca Manganiello doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Gianluca Manganiello has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 2:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
42' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
40' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Yann Bisseck (Inter). The ball is out of play and Inter manage to earn a corner.
35' Inter are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
33' Lorenzo Montipo displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Marko Arnautovic (Inter) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
30' Ball possession – 72:28.
27' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
27' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Joaquin Correa (Inter) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
23' Matteo Darmian (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Manganiello had an easy-decision to make.
20' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
19' Joaquin Correa (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
16' A pass into the box finds Amin Sarr (Verona) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Josep Martinez denies him.
13' That's unlucky! Piotr Zielinski (Inter) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.

12' Suat Serdar (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gianluca Manganiello with no other option than to blow for a foul. Inter get a free kick.
9' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kristjan Asllani (Inter) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Lorenzo Montipo no chance!
8' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
8' It’s a PENALTY to Inter after the VAR review!

7' Play continues despite the shouts by some Inter players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Gianluca Manganiello interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
6' Surely that's handball by one of the Verona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
5' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Gianluca Manganiello.
